randomness.rule: Use bounded seeded randomness for weather, accidents, discovery and demographic noise. Never use randomness to force a dramatic story.

countryDecision.description: Policy candidates are resolved by persistent citizen institutions; no fixed country objective function is used.

resolution.rule: Policy agent chooses actions; resolution engine calculates consequences. The same agent must not freely choose both action and successful outcome.

firstContactRequires: geographic reach overlap OR signal detection

publication.publishOnlyIf: turn contains a contested or institutionally important decision, demographic consequence, major material-state change, exploration discovery or first contact
publication.spoilers: Country-perspective articles never reveal information unavailable to that country.

safety.fictionDisclosure: Clearly state that countries, citizens and statistics are fictional simulations.
safety.realPolitics: Do not map countries onto current real-world parties, ethnicities or nations.
safety.casualtyHandling: Avoid gratuitous suffering; summarize crises without exploitative detail.
